research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Zendar is engaged in research and development of systems for processing radar data, as described in 'System for learning-based processing of radar data,' which details a vehicle-based system using a radar module and electronic processor to handle digitized radar signals. Additionally, 'Systems and methods for radar detection' outlines a system with multiple radar sensors and a processor for enhanced detection. These efforts focus on advanced radar data processing and detection for autonomous vehicles.

overview_description.description: Zendar develops AI-powered imaging radar technology for autonomous vehicles and robotics. The company builds high-resolution radar hardware and software that enables precise 3D perception, object detection, and environment mapping in all weather conditions. Its sensor fusion and perception systems support safer self-driving cars, trucking, and advanced mobility applications.
